rv.q: Coronation may not be the best political satire but, considering everything it tries to accomplish, it is pretty impressive.
But it sure might encourage you to consider what’s worth saving, and what we need to change, before it’s too late.
I found myself tuning out even the most climactic parts of the story, and I wasn’t the only one looking at my watch.

cn.t: This timely feminist satire tackles patriarchy, politics, and AI with ambitious scope, though critics split on its execution—some find it painfully relevant while others see it as overly sprawling in its dystopian warnings.
